选择 APK 后显示名称和图标: App name and icon appear after selecting an APK
未能读取应用名称: App name could not be read
此 APK 未声明可用的设备管理接收器。: This APK has no supported device admin receiver.
此应用将获得设备管理权限，可以限制设备功能。正式管理应用通常无法通过 ADB 移: This app will gain device management permissions and can restrict device features. Production admin apps usually cannot be removed via ADB. Without an in-app removal option, a factory reset that erases data may be required.
安装成功后将自动检查设备，符合条件时设置设备所有者。: After installation, ADM checks the device and sets the device owner if it meets the requirements.
应用已安装，设备所有者已设置。: App installed and device owner verified.
应用已安装。设备所有者配置未完成：{reason}: App installed. Device owner setup did not complete: {reason}
已配置其他设备所有者：{value}: The device already has another owner: {value}
应用尚未安装到主用户：{value}: The app is not installed for the primary user: {value}
设备仍有账号，请在设备设置中处理后重试。: Remove existing accounts in device settings, then try again.
设备已有工作资料管理者。: The device already has a work profile owner.
此系统未提供设备管理功能。: This system does not support device administration.
未找到已启用的设备管理组件，请核对 Receiver 声明。: No enabled admin receiver was found. Check the receiver declaration.
仅支持单一主用户（用户 0），请处理其他用户或工作资料。: Only the primary user (user 0) is supported. Check for other users or work profiles.
无法确认设备账号状态，请检查系统权限限制。: Could not check device accounts. Check system permission restrictions.
命令已提交，但未确认设备所有者，请刷新核对。: Command sent, but the owner could not be verified. Refresh to check.
选择管理应用或手动填写组件，然后检查条件。: Select an admin app or enter a component, then check requirements.
此应用将获得设备管理权限，可以管理设备设置及限制。: This app will gain administrative control over device settings and restrictions.
扫描已安装的管理应用，或手动填写组件后检查条件。: Scan installed admin apps, or enter a component and check requirements.
正在扫描设备上的管理应用…: Scanning admin apps on this device…
未找到可用的管理应用，请先在设备上安装管理应用。: No eligible admin apps found. Install an admin app on the device first.
未收到可解码画面，请重新连接或降低清晰度。: No decodable video received. Reconnect or lower video quality.
设备画面，点击控制，拖动滑动: Device screen. Click to control; drag to swipe.
点击操作，拖动滑动，右键返回: Click to control, drag to swipe, right-click to go back
将文本粘贴到设备当前输入框，会替换设备剪贴板。: Paste into the current input field. This replaces the device clipboard.
将重启此设备，当前连接和未保存的操作会中断。: Restart this device? Current connections and unsaved operations will be interrupted.
将关闭此设备，之后需要手动开机才能重新连接。: Shut down this device? You will need to turn it on manually to reconnect.
当前系统不支持视频解码，请更新 macOS 或 Windows WebView2: Video decoding is unavailable. Update macOS or Windows WebView2 and retry.
设备所有者应用不支持停止、清除数据或卸载。: Device owner apps cannot be stopped, cleared or uninstalled.
此应用没有可用的启动入口。: This app has no available launch activity.
主 APK 与拆分 APK 的合计，不含应用数据和缓存。: Total size of the base and split APKs, excluding app data and cache.
按关联进程判断，包含后台和缓存进程；约每 5 秒更新。: Based on associated processes, including background and cached processes; updated about every 5 seconds.
将删除此应用的登录状态、设置、数据库及缓存，无法撤销。应用仍会保留安装。: This permanently deletes login sessions, settings, databases and cache. The app remains installed.
将停止此应用的所有关联进程，当前任务可能中断；保存的数据不会被清除。: Stops all processes associated with this app. Current tasks may be interrupted; saved data will be kept.
已执行强制停止，运行状态将重新读取。: Force stop completed. Process status will be refreshed.
连接后可查看实时性能曲线。: Connect a device to view live performance charts.
当前设备不支持读取 CPU 占用。: CPU usage is unavailable on this device.
当前设备不支持读取网络计数。: Network counters are unavailable on this device.
选择一个应用，查看性能数据。: Select an app to view its performance.
FPS：应用界面每秒绘制的帧数。画面静止时可为 0。: FPS: UI frames drawn per second. A static screen may show 0.
卡顿比例：采样期间，系统判定为卡顿的帧所占比例。: Janky frames: the percentage of frames the system identifies as janky during the sampling interval.
PSS：应用占用的内存，共享内存按比例计入。: PSS: app memory usage, including a proportional share of shared memory.
帧率来自 Android 界面渲染统计（HWUI），不代表屏幕刷新率，部分游戏和: Frame rates use Android UI rendering statistics (HWUI), not the display refresh rate. Some game and video frames are not included.
暂无帧率数据，应用可能未运行或不支持此项统计。: No frame-rate data. The app may not be running or may not support these statistics.
部分日志缺少 UID，无法按应用归属筛选。: Some entries have no UID and cannot be matched to an app.
拖动调整列宽，双击恢复默认: Drag to resize; double-click to reset
日志列表，选择一行查看完整内容: Log list. Select a row to view its full text.
请选择已连接的设备查看日志。: Select a connected device to view logs.
所选应用已不存在，请重新选择应用。: The selected app is no longer available. Select an app again.
按主用户的应用 UID 筛选；共享 UID 的应用可能同时显示。: Filters by app UID for user 0; apps sharing the UID may also appear.
暂停滚动时仍继续接收日志。: Logs keep arriving while scrolling is paused.
导出当前筛选下已缓存的日志，包含暂停滚动期间收到的内容。: Exports cached logs matching the current filters, including those received while scrolling was paused.
连接 USB，或添加网络设备: Connect via USB or add a network device
拖动调整设备列表宽度: Drag to resize the device list
查看和管理设备上的已安装应用。: View and manage apps installed on the device.
应用列表尚未加载，请刷新。: App list not loaded. Refresh to try again.
卸载将删除应用及其数据，此操作无法撤销。: This removes the app and its data. This cannot be undone.
系统应用仅支持查看，不支持卸载。: System apps can be viewed but cannot be uninstalled here.
应用已卸载，已核对设备上的结果。: App uninstalled and verified on the device.
应用已卸载，但列表刷新失败，请手动刷新。: App uninstalled, but the list could not be refreshed. Refresh it manually.
松开以打开安装窗口: Drop to open the install dialog
应用已安装，但列表刷新失败，请手动刷新。: App installed, but the list could not be refreshed. Refresh it manually.
连接 Android 设备，开始管理: Connect an Android device to get started
备注仅在本机显示，留空恢复设备原名称。: Names are saved on this computer. Leave blank to use the original name.
请解锁设备并允许此电脑进行调试。: Unlock the device and authorize this computer for debugging.
设备连接后，可查看系统信息并配置设备所有者。: Connect a device to view system information and configure its device owner.
检查通过，可以设置设备所有者。: Requirements met. You can now set the device owner.
移除后，此应用将失去设备管理权限；应用及其数据会保留。: The app will lose device management privileges. The app and its data will be kept.
此管理应用未以测试模式激活，Android 不允许通过 ADB 移除。请在管理应: This admin was not activated in test mode. Android does not allow ADB removal. Release device management from within the management app.
先安装管理应用，再检查组件、主用户和账号状态。: Install the management app first, then check the component, primary user and accounts.
确认将此设备授权给上述管理应用: Authorize the management app above to manage this device
也可拖入 APK 文件: You can also drop an APK file
支持单个完整的 Android 安装包: One complete Android APK at a time
配对成功，请填写无线调试主页上的连接地址。: Paired. Enter the connection address shown on the main Wireless debugging screen.
连接后，设备会自动出现在左侧列表。: Connected devices appear automatically in the device list.
在 Android 设备上开启开发者选项与 USB 调试。: Enable Developer options and USB debugging on the Android device.
使用支持数据传输的 USB 线连接电脑。: Connect to your computer with a data-capable USB cable.
解锁设备，允许这台电脑进行调试。: Unlock the device and authorize this computer.
Windows 未识别设备时，请安装设备厂商的 ADB 驱动。: If Windows cannot detect the device, install the manufacturer’s ADB driver.
在设备「无线调试 → 使用配对码配对设备」中查看地址和配对码。: Find the address and code under Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code.
电脑与设备需处于可互通的网络。无线调试的连接端口与配对端口通常不同。: The computer and device must be reachable on the network. Connection and pairing usually use different ports.
删除后无法恢复，文件夹内的所有内容也会一并删除。: This cannot be undone. All contents of a folder will also be deleted.
浏览共享存储、上传和下载文件。: Browse shared storage, upload and download files.
自有代码采用 MIT 许可: Original code is licensed under MIT
切换后立即生效，无需重新启动。: Changes take effect immediately. No restart required.
优先使用随应用附带的 ADB，也可指定本机 platform-tools。: Use the bundled ADB, or choose ADB from your local platform-tools.
请一次拖入一个完整 APK。: Drop one complete APK at a time.
安装成功，已核对设备上的安装版本。: Installed and verified the version on the device.
部分 macOS 系统菜单将在重启应用后使用所选语言。: Some macOS system menus will use the selected language after restarting the app.
